# Streamfinder · Moritz Vollmer

> A German-language web application by Moritz Vollmer for finding streaming, rental, and purchase availability for films and TV series in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

## Canonical Page

- https://streamfinder.moritzvollmer.de/

## Function

Users search for films and TV series and view provider availability. A watchlist is stored locally by default. After optional account login, users can create, label, rename, and synchronize multiple lists across devices.

Search results come from IMDb, detail metadata from Cinemeta, and provider links from WatchHub. Provider availability can change at short notice. Users should confirm availability with the provider before purchasing or subscribing.

## Data Sources

- IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/
- Cinemeta: https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/
- WatchHub: https://watchhub.strem.io/

## Author

- Moritz Vollmer: https://moritzvollmer.de/
